findings.claim: Endpoint high-versus-low integrated contrasts are signed and feature-specific rather than a single global shift: global_centroid_y is negative (q=0.0136, 21% positive batches) while global_centroid_x and global_centroid_z are not distinguishable from zero (q=0.257 and q=0.481). This is a directional coordinate contrast at the observed endpoint, not an absolute geometric descriptor.

Shape/anisotropy coordinates carry the strongest coherent endpoint contrasts: shape_yy is strongly negative (q=1.5e-5, 0% positive batches) and shape_xx negative (q=8.1e-4, 7% positive batches), with shape_yz also negative (q=0.035). These are consistent signed contrasts across batches, distinct from the null centroid_x/z rows.

Pair-kernel endpoint contrasts are positive and monotone in the short-to-mid range: pair_kernel_1.5 (q=1.5e-4, 100% positive batches), pair_kernel_2.5 (q=2.2e-5, 100%), pair_kernel_3.5 (q=9.8e-5, 100%) and pair_kernel_5.0 (q=3.7e-3, 86%), while pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (q=1.5e-4, 0%). The sign reversal at 7.0 A indicates a scale-dependent contrast rather than a uniform density increase.

Landmark occupancy and softmin contrasts are heterogeneous by landmark: landmark_00_occupancy3 is positive (q=2.4e-4, 100% positive batches) and landmark_00_softmin negative (q=8.1e-4, 0%), whereas landmark_01_occupancy3/5 and landmark_02_occupancy3/5 are negative (q=0.0037, 0.0056, 0.0026, 0.0026) and landmark_01/02/03_softmin are positive (q=0.043, 0.0046, 0.013). Occupancy and softmin at the same landmark carry opposite signs, so they are not redundant descriptors of one effect.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary under coordinate-only control; the endpoint contrasts above are coordinate-reward evidence, not measured affinity benefit, and no decoded terminal affinity labels are present in the delivered observations.

hypotheses.direction: increase short-range pair-kernel occupancy; decrease long-range (7.0 A) kernel; negative shape_yy/shape_xx
hypotheses.falsifier: If a permitted endpoint-coordinate reward recipe that raises short-range pair-kernel occupancy does not also lower the 7.0 A kernel or does not reproduce the negative shape_yy/shape_xx contrast, the joint-pattern hypothesis fails.
hypotheses.observable: endpoint high-versus-low integrated z for pair_kernel_1.5-5.0, pair_kernel_7.0 and shape_yy/shape_xx
hypotheses.scope: observed endpoint window [0.0,0.5], selection-node coordinate contrasts
hypotheses.statement: A signed endpoint coordinate contrast that increases short-range pair-kernel occupancy (1.5-5.0 A) while decreasing the 7.0 A kernel and shifting shape_yy/shape_xx negative is a coherent joint pattern, not an isolated marginal descriptor.

hypotheses.direction: landmark_00 occupancy3 up with softmin down; landmark_01/02 occupancy down with softmin up
hypotheses.falsifier: If occupancy and softmin at the same landmark move with the same sign under a permitted regional-attention recipe, the opposite-sign coupling claim fails.
hypotheses.observable: endpoint high-versus-low integrated z for landmark_XX_occupancy3/5 and landmark_XX_softmin
hypotheses.scope: observed endpoint window, per-landmark regional attention
hypotheses.statement: Landmark occupancy and softmin contrasts at the same landmark are opposite-signed, so a landmark-attention reward that targets occupancy alone would not express the softmin component and vice versa.

limitations: Only endpoint_effects rows were read; increment, survival, turnover, joint-diagnostic, branch-adjusted, continuous-trend, regional, lineage, information-audit and curve-support tables were not inspected, so immediate-selection versus descendant-survival credit, turnover-residual accounting, multiplicity-adjusted coverage ranking and joint covariance/mode diagnostics are not addressed here.
No decoded terminal affinity labels or independent-batch survival/quality credit were delivered, so last-record or endpoint coordinate contrasts cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
Pair-kernel, landmark and shape quantities are coordinate-reward diagnostics; they are not physical interaction energies and do not establish neural-module causation.
No permitted reward recipe was executed in this lane, so the hypotheses remain descriptive and untested.
